source.public_versification_note: Public 25:1–18, 26:2–65, 27–28 and 29:1–39 align directly. Public 26:1 combines Hebrew 25:19 and 26:1, each bound separately in source_segments. Public 29:40 maps to Hebrew 30:1; public 30:1–16 maps to Hebrew 30:2–17. All 194 original records are hashed exactly for 193 public verses.

key_decisions.decision: Keeps the sexual and unfaithfulness force of zanah without asserting payment or an otherwise unstated fertility ritual.
Retains the yoking image of attachment and identifies the local Baal without collapsing it into a generic idol.
Preserves all leaders and the severe public punishment; notes uncertainty over hanging, impalement and the pronoun’s reference instead of adding only guilty leaders.
Makes each judge’s responsibility clear while preserving the death command and repeated yoking language.
Retains both victims, the woman’s bodily injury and the stated end of the plague; does not invent an explicit sexual position or shrine setting.
Preserves repeated lineage, divine attribution and zeal repeated as the explanation of the violent act.
Retains descendant scope, lasting priesthood and atonement language without adding a theory of how the killing effects atonement.
Preserves the repeated hostility/scheming explanation, Cozbi’s kinship and both named affairs as the divine speech states them.
